title: Juneau Tours and Whale Watch
specs: Located in Alaska's Inside Passage, a prime feeding ground for humpback whales
Custom-built catamarans with exceptional stability and smooth rides
Heated cabins and multiple outdoor viewing decks for comfort and photography
Private charters available for families, corporate groups, weddings, photography groups, and large inbound tour groups

blurb: Guests join whale watching tours on custom-built catamarans in Alaska's Inside Passage to see humpback whales and other wildlife. Tours include a trained naturalist and heated cabins with large viewing windows. Private charters and land tours are also available for groups and special events.
extraNote: 100% Whale Sighting Guarantee from May 15 to September 15 or full refund · No Port, No Pay policy if cruise ship is delayed or cannot dock · Tours scheduled around cruise ship arrival and departure times · Check-in beneath the Goldbelt Tramway (Mount Roberts Tramway) in downtown Juneau, near cruise ship docks. · May 15 through September 15
